rows.name: Crime in England and Wales: Appendix tables — year ending March 2026
rows.semantic_limit: National offence-type and survey/recorded-crime tables provide authoritative trend context only; they do not identify an exact parcel, incident address or anonymised street point.
rows.evidence_basis: Official ONS dataset page identifies the year-ending March 2026 edition, release date 2026-07-23 and national crime-table scope.

rows.name: Crime in England and Wales: Police Force Area data tables — year ending March 2026
rows.semantic_limit: Police Force Area and Community Safety Partnership figures can calibrate regional context, but must not be represented as exact parcel-level or street-level measurement.
rows.evidence_basis: Official ONS dataset page states police-recorded crime coverage by Police Force Area and Community Safety Partnership and release date 2026-07-23.

rows.name: Crime in England and Wales — year ending March 2026 bulletin
rows.semantic_limit: The bulletin supports release methodology, caveats and national interpretation; it is not an independent parcel observation and cannot release a parcel safety score.
rows.evidence_basis: Official ONS bulletin links the 2026-07-23 appendix, Police Force Area and supplementary datasets.

rows.name: data.police.uk ASB incidents, crime and outcomes — provenance, QA and licence
rows.publisher: Single Online Home National Digital Team
rows.semantic_limit: Monthly police open data are anonymised and quality-assured, but location accuracy varies and published coordinates are approximate; no exact incident-to-parcel binding is permitted.
rows.evidence_basis: Official page states monthly frequency, coverage through June 2026, OGL v3.0, police-force provenance, QA, anonymisation and known location-accuracy limits.

rows.name: data.police.uk street-level crimes API method
rows.publisher: Single Online Home National Digital Team
rows.semantic_limit: The endpoint supports point-radius or polygon queries and monthly filtering, but returned locations are expressly approximate and must not be treated as the exact place of a crime or exact parcel evidence.
rows.evidence_basis: Official API documentation defines point/polygon parameters, latest-month default, response fields and explicit approximate-location warning.
